message: Letting out mournful wails, the demons scattered and fled.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could it be that our special training is already paying off?」

name: Synn
message: 「Man, we're just like shonen manga protagonists.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Pride, envy, wrath, sloth, greed, gluttony, and lust, right!」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if she's okay on her own... I hope she doesn't run into any demons.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Don't tell me you didn't know, nya!? I introduced myself at the very beginning, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Pasta has a super cute name--Pasta, nya!」

name: Azel
message: 「Pasta, huh. But you don't know my name either.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Don't take me for a fool, nya! You're Azel, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「...You're totally throwing off my rhythm, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Tell me if the Student Council is coming to the academy tomorrow, nya.」

name: Azel
message: 「They should be coming. However, there won't be any patrol.」

name: Pasta
message: 「That works out great, nya. It won't cause trouble for Prier, nya. If I win secretly, I can keep eating sweets from now on and keep working until payday, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I'm gonna gather a whole bunch of underlings and have them attack, nya!」

name: Azel
message: 「Just earlier. Your subordinates were defeated by the Student Council.」

name: Pasta
message: 「If it's come to this, Pasta has no choice but to step in too, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「At this rate, I'm going to disappoint Bylous-nyama, nya. I've gotta make a comeback right here, nya!」

name: Azel
message: 「Is it out of personal affection for Bylous?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Wh-Why, nya!? How do you know Pasta is in love with Bylous-nyama, nya!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「You're a nicer guy than I thought, nya.」
